title: Tower Defense Wave Generation and Enemy Scheduling
subtitle: A deep dive into tower defense wave data structures and enemy scheduling logic. We explore wave DSL configuration for pressure curves and intelligent spawning strategies, offering a complete solution from basic numerical balancing to dynamic level pacing to help developers build flexible and varied tower defense stages.
